name: chart-tooltip
title: Chart Tooltip
description: The hover readout shared by the chart components: a muted caption over a value row, with a tail pointing at the anchor. Uses namespace exports: ChartTooltip.Root, ChartTooltip.Value, ChartTooltip.Unit, ChartTooltip.Delta.

docs.lead: A caption over a value, with a tail pointing down at what it describes. The chart components render it on hover; use it directly when you build a custom chart.
docs.usage:
import * as ChartTooltip from "@/components/ui/chart-tooltip"

<ChartTooltip.Root caption="10 - 19 Group">
  <ChartTooltip.Value>168</ChartTooltip.Value>
  <ChartTooltip.Unit>Items</ChartTooltip.Unit>
</ChartTooltip.Root>

examples.title: With unit
examples.description: A caption, a value and what the value counts. The bar chart and the donut use this shape.

examples.title: Without unit
examples.description: Leave the unit out when the card title already names what's being counted.

examples.title: With change
examples.description: Add a Delta after the value to show its change, and what the change is measured against. The line chart uses this shape.

api.name: ChartTooltip.Root
api.description: The box and its tail. Position it above the anchor; it ignores the pointer so it never steals hover.

props.name: caption
props.description: The muted line above the value

props.name: tailOffset
props.description: Px to slide the tail off-centre, when the box is shifted off its anchor (e.g. clamped inside the chart)

api.name: ChartTooltip.Unit
api.description: What the figure counts, beside it.

api.name: ChartTooltip.Delta
api.description: A change beside the figure, green when it is zero or up and red when down. Children name what it is measured against.
